subject: Draft MAP: contract owners + 48h response playbook for MSA/DPA/SLA
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Tim Evans <tim.evans@northridge.com>, Northridge Procurement <procurement@northridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP: contract owners + 48h response playbook for MSA/DPA/SLA

Tim / team — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick written recap and proposed MAP milestone for the contract negotiation leg so we have clear owners and expected turnarounds: 

Summary of where we landed
- Scope: MSA + DPA + proposed SLA (90-day pilot, then production).
- Target close: 2027-07-08 (customer target).
- Primary blocker: legal redline cadence — need an agreed turnaround to avoid slip.

Proposed MAP milestone (Legal redlines & routing) — please confirm: 
1) Initial redline delivery (customer -> Redwood): Northridge to upload annotated MSA/DPA to shared Drive (target: 2027-06-17 EOD).
2) Redwood internal intake & triage: Redwood AE (Alex) to confirm scope vs. playbook and route to in-house counsel / product for any technical SLAs (T=within 4 business hours of upload).
3) Redwood first-pass redline (edits + comments): Redwood to produce marked-up MSA + one-page redline summary (target: 48 business hours from intake). Owner: Redwood legal (via Marissa).
4) Customer review & counter (if any): Northridge to respond within 48 business hours. Owner: Northridge Procurement (Tim).
5) Final alignment & signoff or escalate: if outstanding items remain after two rounds, escalate to exec review (Ben + Tim) with a recommended compromise.

Action items from Redwood side (owners + deadlines)
- Alex: upload consolidated call notes and add Northridge redline link to HubSpot (by 2027-06-15 12:00 PT).
- Marissa (Legal lead): assign Redwood legal reviewer and deliver first-pass redline + one-page summary (target: 48 business hours once Northridge posts their annotated doc).
- Ben (Sales lead): prepare fallback SLA options (quantified latency and retention tradeoffs) and cost delta sheet for exec review (deliverable: 2027-06-18).

Tim — can you confirm the Northridge internal reviewers and whether the 48h review window is workable on your end? Also confirm if procurement needs any PO template or special clauses up front.

Attachments: redline_MSA_v3.docx (placeholder — current draft), SLA_summary.xlsx (pilot SLA metrics).

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

---
Note: Redwood legal contact for intake is Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>. For scheduling escalations, Ben Carter is the sales escalation lead.

From: Tim Evans <tim.evans@northridge.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Northridge Procurement <procurement@northridge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: contract owners + 48h response playbook for MSA/DPA/SLA

Alex — thanks for the clear recap and proposed cadence. 48h windows sound reasonable for our team; procurement will aim for business‑day 48h turnarounds. A couple of notes: 

- We have a legal SME (Sophie Randall) who will own detailed redlines. I will upload Northridge's annotated MSA to the Drive by EOD Thursday (2027-06-17).
- Our procurement team prefers the first substantive redline to include resolved/accepted bullets to speed internal approvals (sooner rather than a fully tracked doc).
- PO template: we use a standard PO referencing an executed MSA; procurement will attach that if we get to signature.

We'll hold the target close of 2027-07-08 on our side provided we stick to these windows. I'll loop Sophie on a follow-up if needed.

—Tim
Tim Evans
Head of IT Contracts, Northridge Systems
T: +1 617-555-2278

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Evans <tim.evans@northridge.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood internal: redline playbook + escalation thresholds

Marissa / Alex — following Tim's note, quick internal alignment so legal routing is clean: 

1) Intake process: Alex will drop Northridge doc in Drive and open the HubSpot deal note with "redline-ready" tag. Marissa, please confirm who on legal will be assigned (primary & backup). If no reply within 4 business hours of upload, I will ping for assignment.

2) 48h SLA: treat 48 business hours as target TAT for first-pass substantive redline. If the redline includes references to core product behavior (KV cache, regional routing, data retention) — include a product SME note (1-2 bullets) in the one-page summary. 

3) Escalation thresholds: if more than 6 substantive edits to the SLA or any DPA clause with data residency implications, escalate to Ben (sales) + Alex (AE) for exec alignment and proposed concessions.

4) Communication: use the shared Drive thread + HubSpot comment thread for all formal redline uploads to ensure auditability.

Deliverables / deadlines: 
- Marissa: confirm legal reviewer by 2027-06-16 12:00 PT.
- Alex: confirm Drive link + HubSpot note by 2027-06-15 12:00 PT (per your note).
- Ben: I will prepare fallback SLA options by 2027-06-18 EOD and share in Drive.

If Marissa prefers a different TAT or routing, call it out now — I want to avoid surprise holds during Northridge's procurement review.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Tim Evans <tim.evans@northridge.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Northridge Procurement <procurement@northridge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: contract owners + 48h response playbook for MSA/DPA/SLA

Team — quick confirmation: Sophie (legal SME) will be our reviewer; procurement confirms 48 business-hour cadence and we'll upload annotated MSA by 2027-06-17 EOD as promised. We prefer Redwood to include the resolved bullets in the first pass as Ben suggested.

If you can hit the 48h first-pass turnaround, we will aim to complete our counter or accept within 48h and keep to the 2027-07-08 target close. I'll escalate internally if any internal compliance flags appear.

Thanks — looking forward to the draft redline.

Tim
